question: Do the three NON-reading subtractions — de-duplication, skipping evidence that carries no sentence text, and deterministic grounding rejects — account for the reader arms' gain?
finding: No. Applied with no model verdicts at all, they land BELOW the noisy-OR over every evidence entry, with no gate applied.

rows.label: noisy-OR SimpleScorer (direct), every evidence entry
rows.note: The ungated baseline: all evidence, multiplicity retained, no subtraction of any kind.

rows.label: de-dup only
rows.note: One vote per UNIQUE (statement, evidence) pair — the panel the reader arms were built on.

rows.label: de-dup + drop evidence with no sentence
rows.note: Also drops evidence with no sentence to read; the gate never sees these.

rows.label: de-dup + no-sentence + deterministic rejects, no LLM (control)
rows.note: All three non-reading subtractions, every readable pair accepted, no model verdict anywhere.

contrast.label: Gemma 4 26B (same subtractions PLUS reading)
contrast.note: The same three subtractions PLUS the reader's per-evidence verdicts, taken from the shipped bundle rather than recomputed.

route_census.basis: unique (statement, evidence) pairs in the execution map

production_dedup_scope_difference.status: memo-reported; NOT re-derived by this script
production_dedup_scope_difference.why_not_rederived: reproducing it requires the production statement_belief de-dup pass, not the execution map this script reads
production_dedup_scope_difference.conclusion_unchanged: the control sits BELOW the ungated noisy-OR under either de-dup scope

caveats: This is the EXECUTION-MAP pass. It de-duplicates to unique (statement, evidence) pairs as recorded in data/benchmark/indra_paper_unique_pairs_20260717_execution_map.jsonl. Production statement_belief collapses roughly 40 further within-source text-normalized near-duplicates, which needs the production de-dup pass to reproduce and is therefore NOT re-derived here; the memo-reported figures for that scope are carried in production_dedup_scope_difference, clearly marked. The conclusion is the same either way: the control sits below the ungated noisy-OR.

Every row uses the paper's OWN aggregation and the priors the reader bundles declare (data/comparison/aggregation.json): belief = 1 - PROD_s (syst_s + rand_s^{n_s}) over sorted(sources). No model verdict enters rows 1-4 at all.

The de-dup row is not a defect being corrected — it is a scope difference between counting every evidence entry and counting each distinct (statement, evidence) pair once. It is priced here so it cannot be mistaken for a reading gain.
35 statements lose ALL their evidence to the deterministic rejects and score belief 0 in the full control. That is a property of our grounding rules, not of any reader.
Average precision is sklearn's tie-aware average_precision_score throughout; the paper's own trapezoidal PR-AUC is not used here, because it over-credits tied score distributions.

checks.note: Assertions are enforced in code; a violation fails the build rather than being reported here as False.
